messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV2 page - embedding service high error rate in eu-west-1. affected customers: two active tenants showing 15-30% failed requests. auto-fallback engaged.
oncall-sam: Saw the page. I'm on it — collecting logs now. Starting svc restart on node pool A.
alex_k: Thx Sam. Quick ask: do we have a routing fallback to eu-central ready if restart fails?
priya_m: There's a standby pool in eu-central but NAT config might block some private customers. I'll check policy and exceptions.
oncall-sam: Restart done on pool A, some errors dropped to ~6% but tail latency spikes remain. Repro: KV cache eviction warnings in logs.
taylor_sre: Can you paste the eviction log lines? suspect cache thrash after recent deploy.
oncall-sam: ```
2026-03-17T17:12:03Z WARN kvcache: evicting prefix LRU=0.71 entries=128 shard=3
2026-03-17T17:12:04Z ERROR serve: tokenization timeout, downstream retry
``` 
jamie_ops: That aligns with yesterday's rollout of the new cache shard mapping. Rolling it back now.
priya_m: Rollback started. Also opening quick routing rule to divert non-enterprise traffic to eu-central to reduce load in eu-west-1.
maria_pm: Customer impact note: two customers saw degraded embeddings for ~35 minutes. Ops estimates partial RPS recovery on rollback. We should decide on customer crediting now.
alex_k: Recommend credit for affected window for impacted tenants (pro-rate). Keep it minimal but fair. Ops: estimate recovery ETA?
oncall-sam: After rollback + routing change, metrics back to normal. Full recovery around +22m from page.
jamie_ops: Confirming rollback reverted the shard mapping commit c3f2a. No other deploys in window.
priya_m: Routing rule applied and later removed after recovery.
maria_pm: I'll draft credit calc: pro-rate by 22m, apply to billing as a one-time credit. Needs billing review but ok for now.
priya_m: Can we schedule a post-incident review? I'd like root-cause, action items, and a plan to avoid recurrence before quarter planning.
alex_k: Put it on next Tue postmortem slot 10:00am UTC? Invite infra + runtime + PM + support rep.
jamie_ops: I'll own postmortem write-up. Initial action items below (rough sizing):
- kvcache: revert + validate shard-mapping rollout guard (small) — estimate 1d (owner: jamie_ops)
- add eviction backpressure + metrics (medium) — estimate 3d (owner: taylor_sre)
- automated rollback runbook (small) — estimate 2d (owner: oncall-sam)
- routing-policy playbook for cross-region divert (small) — estimate 1d (owner: priya_m)
- billing credit automation for short windows (medium) — estimate 5d (owner: maria_pm)
- long-term: KV cache redesign to reduce cross-shard thrash (large) — rough 2 sprints (owner: alex_k)
maria_pm: For prioritization: kvcache revert + eviction backpressure must be P0 for next sprint. Billing automation P1. KV redesign P2 (Q3 initiative candidate).
taylor_sre: I'll scope the metrics and backpressure design and post a proposal by EOD tomorrow.
oncall-sam: I'll draft the automated rollback runbook and link the quick commands used during mitigation.
alex_k: Add a regression test in CI that simulates shard hot-swap — small effort but prevents rollout regressions. Owner: alex_k, 2d.
jamie_ops: Postmortem meeting scheduled: Tue 2026-03-23 10:00 UTC. I'll create doc and invite. Action items will be tracked in the incident board (link to be posted).
priya_m: tagging support for customer comms. Maria, will you own final credit approval with finance?
maria_pm: Yes, I'll coordinate with finance; will post final credit amounts before EOD tomorrow.
alex_k: Thanks everyone. Quick follow-up: prioritize the revert + backpressure in sprint planning tomorrow. :thumbsup:
maria_pm: noted. Closing the page in Ops now — will update the incident board with owners and sizing.
jamie_ops: closing thread here after adding the doc link.
